user.title: Connect to iQua
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use in the iQua app. The correct API host is detected automatically.

verify.title: Verify your account
verify.description: Your iQua account requires email verification. A confirmation code has been sent to {email} — enter it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate AquaHome
reauth_confirm.description: The stored credentials for {email} no longer work. Enter the current iQua password to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the iQua cloud
error.rate_limited: The iQua cloud is rate-limiting requests — wait a few minutes and try again
error.invalid_code: The confirmation code was not accepted
error.no_devices: No devices found on this iQua account
error.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different iQua account than the one being re-authenticated

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the iQua cloud

rate_limited.message: The iQua cloud is rate-limiting requests; try again in a few minutes

auth_failed.message: Authentication with the iQua cloud failed

setting_rejected.message: The device rejected the setting change: {message}

setting_unavailable.message: This setting is not currently available on the device

invalid_option.message: {option} is not an offered option for this setting

valve_action_blocked.message: The valve does not currently allow this action

analytics_not_ready.message: Usage analytics have not produced a result yet; try again after the next analysis run

regen_not_allowed.message: The device is not accepting this regeneration action right now

salt_level_low.title: Salt is running low on {device}
salt_level_low.description: The softener estimates about {days} days of salt remain. Plan a refill of the brine tank soon.

salt_level_critical.title: Salt is almost empty on {device}
salt_level_critical.description: The softener estimates only about {days} days of salt remain. Refill the brine tank now to keep the water softened.

unique_id_migration.title: AquaHome entity identities were migrated
unique_id_migration.description:
An integration update renamed the internal identity of the following entities. History is preserved, but if you renamed or customized any of them, review the changes:

{renames}

leak_urgent.title: Severe continuous water flow on {device}
leak_urgent.description: Water has been flowing continuously through {device} at roughly {liters_per_day} liters per day, including every overnight hour between 01:00 and 07:00 on consecutive nights. If nobody has been deliberately running water, check for a burst pipe, a running toilet, or an open tap, and consider shutting off the supply.

leak_while_away.title: Water is flowing while nobody is home on {device}
leak_while_away.description: A continuous leak ({tier} tier, roughly {liters_per_day} liters per day) is being detected on {device} while the household appears to be away. Water flowing through an empty house is rarely intentional — check for a burst pipe, a running toilet, or an open tap, and consider shutting off the supply remotely if you can.

vacation_defer.title: Vacation detected — defer regenerations on {device}?
vacation_defer.description: No meaningful water use has been seen on {device} for {consecutive_days} days, which looks like an absence. Regenerating a softener that is treating no water wastes salt and water.

confirm.title: Defer regenerations on {device}
confirm.description: Scheduled regenerations will be cancelled while the house stays empty and resume automatically when water use returns. A regeneration is still allowed through after 21 deferred days to protect the resin bed.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The AquaHome integration is not loaded; try again after it has started.

regen_time.title: Regeneration time on {device} overlaps household water use
regen_time.description: Regenerations on {device} are configured for {current}, but learned usage patterns show water is regularly used at that hour. Softened water is unavailable during a regeneration, so a quieter hour ({proposed}) would fit this household better.

confirm.title: Move the regeneration time on {device}
confirm.description: The regeneration time setting will be changed from {current} to {proposed}. You can change it back at any time from the device settings.

abort.write_failed: Writing the new regeneration time failed; the device setting was not changed.
abort.entry_not_loaded: The AquaHome integration is not loaded; try again after it has started.

options.schedule: Schedule for the next regeneration time

analyze_usage.name: Analyze usage
analyze_usage.description: Returns the full water-usage analysis for a device: nightly leak verdicts, daily usage assessments, anomaly and vacation detection state, tomorrow's forecast, and the learned activity grid.

refresh.name: Refresh first
refresh.description: Recompute the analysis from the latest imported statistics before returning it.

get_usage_forecast.name: Get usage forecast
get_usage_forecast.description: Returns the expected daily water usage for the coming days, derived from the device's own averages and learned statistics.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days ahead to forecast, starting tomorrow.

set_vacation_mode.name: Set vacation mode
set_vacation_mode.description: Turns regeneration deferral on or off. While on, scheduled regenerations are cancelled (with a resin-protection limit) and a catch-up regeneration is scheduled on return if capacity is low. This does not change the vacation tile in the iQua app.

schedule_regeneration.name: Schedule regeneration
schedule_regeneration.description: Schedules, starts, or cancels a regeneration on the targeted device.
